ops.oldText: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: 2.2 Vendor's appointment is non-exclusive. Customer may develop, acquire, or procure hosted analytics or any other services from any source, and nothing in this Agreement restricts Customer's business, products, or fields of use.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot grant exclusivity or otherwise restrict the services we may buy or build, so we have made Vendor's appointment non-exclusive; this also removes the conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3. If Vendor needs protection, we could consider a narrow, product-specific restriction during the term only (max 12 months) with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Convert Section 2.2 exclusivity into a non-exclusive appointment with express confirmation of no restriction on Customer's business.
